
# Synapse Data Model - Forms


<a id="dm-forms"></a>

## Forms

Forms are derived from types, or base types. Forms represent node types in the graph.


<a id="dm-form-auth-passwd"></a>

### auth:passwd

A password string.

The base type for the form can be found at [`auth:passwd`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-auth-passwd).


**Properties:**

| name | type | doc | opts |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:md5` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('crypto:hash:md5',)` | The MD5 hash of the password. | Computed: `True` |
| `:sha1` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('crypto:hash:sha1',)` | The SHA1 hash of the password. | Computed: `True` |
| `:sha256` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('crypto:hash:sha256',)` | The SHA256 hash of the password. | Computed: `True` |
| `:seen` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('ival',)` | The password was observed during the time interval. | virts: `(('min', ('time', {}), {'doc': 'The starting time of the interval.'}), ('max', ('time', {}), {'doc': 'The ending time of the interval.'}), ('duration', ('duration', {}), {'doc': 'The duration of the interval.'}), ('precision', ('timeprecision', {}), {'doc': 'The precision for display and rounding the times.'}))` |

### biz:deal

A sales or procurement effort in pursuit of a purchase.

The base type for the form can be found at [`biz:deal`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-biz-deal).


**Properties:**

| name | type | doc | opts |

| `:id` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('base:id',)` | An identifier for the deal. |  |
| `:name` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('base:name',)` | The name of the deal. |  |
| `:type` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('biz:deal:type:taxonomy',)` | The type of deal. |  |
| `:status` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('title',)` | The status of the deal. |  |
| `:updated` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('time',)` | The last time the deal had a significant update. | virts: `(('precision', ('timeprecision', {}), {'doc': 'The precision for display and rounding the time.'}),)` |

| `:proxy` | [`poly`](datamodel_types.md#dm-type-poly)<br>types: `('crypto:currency:address',)` | The address granted proxy authority to manipulate fungible tokens. |
